defendant: Med Stream Holding, INC., Jamal-Abu-Diab, an individual, et. al.
description:
Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. F992225
Sheriff’s File # 26000550
PLAINTIFF – Allstate Realty LLC vs:
DEFENDANTS- Med Stream Holding, INC., Jamal-Abu-Diab, an individual, et. al.
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 22nd day of June, 2026
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in Freehold Township, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Lot and Block: Lot 7, Block 56 Tax Map of Township of Freehold
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
190 South Street Freehold Township, NJ
Approximate Dimensions of the property: 60 x 148.
Nearest Cross Street: South Street and Irwin Avenue
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by Plaintiff prior to this sale. Subject to all zoning laws. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interests remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon.
The property is being sold subject to any and all tenancies, possessory interests and/or leases, if any, affecting the premises not made party defendants. There are tenants in possession. The property is subject to certain easements and restrictions of record. Parties must conduct a search to obtain a copy of these restrictions.
The sale of this property is subject to the following:
1. Outstanding water and sewer charges as in the approximate amount of $183.41 as of March 12, 2026.
2. Outstanding municipal tax liens in the approximate amount of $32,940.40 as of March 12, 2026; and
3. Second Quarter Taxes in the amount of $2,455.22.
All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interests remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon. The purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagee or agent of the Mortgagee’s attorneys. If the sale is set aside for any reason the purchaser at the sale shall be entitled to only a return of the deposit paid. The purchaser shall have no further recourse against the mortgagor, the mortgagee or the mortgagee’s attorney.
As the above description does not constitute a full legal description, said full legal description can be found at the Monmouth County Sheriff’s office is annexed to certain mortgages as follows:
1. Recorded on November 15, 2021 in the Office of the Clerk of Monmouth County as instrument #2021165852 (re-recorded as instrument #2025072222) and the Writ of Execution on file with the Sheriff of Monmouth County.
The approximate anticipated upset price and amount to be satisfied by the sale of this property is $291,648.75 consisting of $281.174.75 for the judgement $4,172.89 for attorneys' fees and costs and interest at $50.81 per day from February 19, 2026 through the date of the Sheriff's Sale.(June 22,2026).
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $302,889.86.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: March 19, 2026
Foss San Filippo & Milne LLC
PO Box 896
225 Broad St
Red Bank, NJ 07701-0896
732-741-2525
